text: Thinking of AA/A/BBB for Aster, A/BBB/BB for Borealis, BBB/BB/B for Coral, BB/B/B for Dunlin. Any thoughts on the senior tranches for the mandate?
Agree on Aster AA/A/BBB. Borealis senior looks A for mandate. Coral senior might be BBB if we ignore the collection dip. Dunlin senior probably BB.

C, I'm aligned on Aster (AA/A/BBB) and Dunlin (BB/B/B). For Borealis, A/BBB/BB for the senior secured/unsecured feels right given the 4.75x springing covenant. Coral senior secured at BBB seems reasonable if the asset pool is solid, though the 95% collection efficiency is a red flag. Let's coordinate on the IG ratings to ensure they stick for the mandate.
B, D - C and I are leaning AA/A/BBB for Aster and A/BBB/BB for Borealis. Any thoughts?
C's view on Aster (AA/A/BBB) and Borealis (A/BBB/BB) looks fair. Coral and Dunlin seem HY. For the mandate, AA/A for AST-SEC/UNS and A/BBB for BOR-SEC/UNS?
B, I agree. Aster AA/A and Borealis A/BBB should work for the mandate. I'll stick with that.
